record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Characterize those Banach lattice algebras A for which the left regular representation \(a\mapsto L_a\) , where \(L_a(x)=a x\) , into the space of regular operators \({\mathcal L}^r(A)\) preserves finite suprema and infima, as well as being an algebra homomorphism. Even an answer for Dedekind complete Banach lattice algebras would be of interest, when we are asking about it being a lattice homomorphism. In addition, consider when such representations are either faithful or isometric. The natural norm to take on \({\mathcal L}^r(A)\) would be the regular norm, but it is conceivable that the question might be of interest for the operator norm as well.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be a Banach lattice algebra; that is, $A$ is simultaneously a Banach lattice and a Banach algebra such that the product of any two positive elements is positive. Let $\mathcal{L}^r(A)$ denote the space of regular operators on $A$ (i.e., linear operators expressible as a difference of two positive operators), equipped either with the regular norm $\|T\|_r=\inf\{\|S\|:\pm T\le S\}$ or with the operator norm. For each $a\in A$ let $L_a\in\mathcal{L}^r(A)$ be the left multiplication operator $L_a(x)=ax$.

(1) Characterize those Banach lattice algebras $A$ for which the left regular representation $\pi:A\to\mathcal{L}^r(A)$, $a\mapsto L_a$, is simultaneously an algebra homomorphism and a lattice homomorphism (i.e., preserves finite suprema and finite infima).

(2) In particular, give such a characterization in the case where $A$ is Dedekind complete.

(3) Determine, in either of the above settings, when the representation $\pi$ is faithful, and when it is isometric, both for the regular norm and for the operator norm on $\mathcal{L}^r(A)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is described in recent literature on Banach lattice algebras as a fundamental open problem. Surveys and follow-up papers from 2015 onward (including works on Banach lattice algebras and recent 2023–2025 preprints on Riesz representation theorems for vector lattices of regular operators) continue to list characterizing when the left regular representation is a lattice homomorphism—and the related faithful/isometric representation question—as unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Banach lattice algebras: some questions, but very few answers
status_evidence.snippet: A key question is whether the left regular representation π : A → L^r(A) is a lattice homomorphism.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open question in the Banach lattice algebra literature.

status_evidence.title: Riesz representation theorems for vector lattices and Banach lattices of regular operators
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses representation of Banach lattice algebras into L^r(X) and related open problems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work still treats faithful lattice/algebra representation into regular operators as an open program.
